## Description

#### Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. [An estimated $124 trillion of assets](https://www.cerulli.com/press-releases/cerulli-anticipates-124-trillion-in-wealth-will-transfer-through-2048) will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

#### About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Robinhood’s Crypto team owns how customers experience crypto at Robinhood, from buying their first coin to trading actively and going onchain with products that bring centralized and decentralized finance together.

As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll own design strategy and execution across retail crypto trading as well as support our onchain experiences. You’ll balance ambitious 0-to-1 bets that define new categories with the iterative, detail-driven work that makes our existing products faster, clearer, and more reliable. You’ll partner closely with engineering, product, compliance, and legal, and help shape the long-term vision for retail crypto at Robinhood.

Design at Robinhood is AI-first. This role is for someone who already uses AI as a core part of how they think, explore, and execute.

**This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.**

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

#### What you'll do

- Lead and execute the product design strategy for our retail crypto experiences, balancing new bets with iterative improvements to our core surfaces.
- Collaborate directly with engineering, product, design leadership, and legal and compliance partners from initial concept to final launch.
- Bring clarity to complexity by turning complex concepts into highly usable and intuitive experiences that work for first-time users and crypto natives alike.
- Use AI to explore problem spaces, surface edge cases, and prototype quickly, while you guide intent, structure, and quality.
- Uphold the craft bar, and help set the standard for design quality across the crypto team.

#### What you bring

- Strong product design experience working on complex, consumer-facing products with end-to-end ownership
- Active use of AI in your design workflow
- Solid systems thinking, balancing detail with the big picture
- Experience partnering with engineering, product, research, legal, and compliance in a highly regulated environment
- A strong bias for action: able to find the next step and move forward through ambiguity.
- Crypto curiosity— deep expertise isn't required, but fluency and eagerness to learn is required

#### What we offer

- Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
- Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
- Best in class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
- Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
- Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
- Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
